title: Restrict SORTENTSTABLE output qualification to documented DXF owner scope

authority.relevantRule: Group code 330 owner is currently only the *MODEL_SPACE or *PAPER_SPACE blocks; DRAWORDER stores the table under ACAD_SORTENTS in the space block extension dictionary.
authority.interpretation: A source table owned by a named block is not eligible for this DXF output qualification, even when source graph and emitted record comparisons pass.

source.note: Existing local investigation input. It was not added to Git and no DWG/DXF fixture was committed.

independentProfileSource.scope: Corroborates the four table handles, owning BLOCK_HEADER handles and names; not used as normative DXF authority.

implementation.summary: The AC1024 SORTENTSTABLE output-capture predicate now admits only source BLOCK_RECORD names matching *MODEL_SPACE or *PAPER_SPACE. The existing ASCII-insensitive identifier helper requires uppercase comparison literals. A manual selector verifies physical table callback identities against that scope in ASCII and Binary output.
implementation.scope: The source Model Space SORTENTSTABLE callback 0x00F3 qualifies. Named-block table callbacks 0x106A, 0x111C and 0x121D remain unqualified. This does not establish native draw order semantics or whole-document conversion.

ownerScope.result: PASS for ASCII and Binary: only 0x00F3 qualified; named-block tables remained unqualified.

physicalReadbackRollbackRetry.result: PASS for ASCII and Binary, including 88 ordered pairs, atomic refusal with sentinel preservation, same-adapter retry and fresh readback. Negative-control refusal diagnostics are expected.

planImpact.remaining: P4 stays open. Named-block owner profiles remain unresolved for output qualification unless an authoritative DXF route or independent semantic evidence establishes an eligible representation. The broader source/graph closure and strict conversion gate remain open.
planImpact.priorEvidenceDisposition: The earlier multi-table receipt remains historical proof of emitted bytes and readback. Its named-block callbacks are not counted as support-eligible output qualification under the Autodesk owner schema.
